HOW TO TEST

Let the argument breathe.

  1. Allow microphone access.
  2. Hold either speak button and talk.
  3. Interrupt from the other side while translated speech is playing.
  4. Watch unstable words update and the final meaning settle.

Chrome provides the best speech-recognition support. Translation uses the browser Translator API when available and a bounded Hindi–English demo dictionary otherwise.
